Definition: genitive case of G3739 as adverb; at which place, i.e. where:--where(-in), whither(-soever).
BiblicalUsage: The word hoû carries the sense of where, whither. In Matthew 2:9, the text says "which they saw in the east."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hoû, I take at face value: where, whither.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: Jesus Rejected at Nazareth; The Magi Visit Jesus
